title: Probabilistic Scheduling
tagline: Compare queue assignment rules by how quickly they tame tail latency under bursty load.

curves.label: Random Assignment
curves.code: for (let t=0; t<n; t++){ let q = Math.floor(Math.random()*m); queues[q].push(job(t)); } simulateMakespan();
curves.name: Random Assignment

curves.label: Least Expected Load
curves.code: for (let t=0; t<n; t++){ let qBest=0; for(let q=1;q<m;q++){ if(score(q,queues[q],t) < score(qBest,queues[qBest],t)) qBest=q; } queues[qBest].push(job(t)); } simulateMakespan();
curves.name: Least Expected Load

curves.label: Power of Two Choices
curves.code: for (let t=0; t<n; t++){ let a=Math.floor(Math.random()*m), b=Math.floor(Math.random()*m); let q=(queues[a].len<=queues[b].len)?a:b; queues[q].push(job(t)); } simulateMakespan();
curves.name: Power of Two Choices

curves.label: Round-Robin with Backlog
curves.code: let idx=0; for(let t=0;t<n;t++){ queues[idx].push(job(t)); idx=(idx+1)%m; } simulateBacklogPenalty();
curves.name: Round-Robin with Backlog

curves.label: Greedy Longest Queue
curves.code: for (let t=0; t<n; t++){ let qWorst=0; for(let q=1;q<m;q++){ if(queues[q].len > queues[qWorst].len) qWorst=q; } queues[qWorst].push(job(t)); } simulateMakespan();
curves.name: Greedy Longest Queue
